kind: Scoped code and automated application audit

checks.scope: Mocked authentication/database plus real loopback HTTP: foreign-origin write denied, anonymous access denied, owner-derived photo paths, secure cookies and conflict handling. Does not replace hosted RLS testing or a penetration test.

Synthetic files: terminal photos removed, result metadata expires without a new request, cancellation survives restart, orphan cleanup, failed writes and bounded queues. Production default result TTL is 30 minutes; tests use accelerated clocks/TTLs.

Owner-only storage DELETE policy exists, but garment removal does not trigger stored-object deletion and the app has no complete account-erasure workflow. Do not describe garment removal as full deletion.
Application requests opt out of response storage where configured; photos selected for analysis still leave the device. Provider-side retention and downstream erasure were not audited.
Synthetic provider via real application HTTP; cache/coalescing, bounded queue and explicit stale fallback. Slow unique queries can still receive 503 with Retry-After; no production throughput claim.

Source-linked product pages, observed USD amounts, budget bounds and guarded redirects are tested. Real-time price, selected variant, stock, sizing, shipping and catalog freshness are not independently verified.
Document data boundaries, owned-garment rules, purchase evidence and foreign-owner denial. This does not establish fashion quality or complete prompt-injection resistance.
Rehearsals excluded from human denominators; missing acceptance and correction-time values remain null. No independent user outcomes produced by this audit.
Reduced-motion and navigation continuity logic tested. Full WCAG 2.2 assessment, contrast coverage, screen-reader testing and real assistive-technology sessions remain untested.

limits: No paid model calls or external deployment changes.
No formal WCAG, provider-retention or full-erasure certification.
